name: Discovering Engineering (University of Maryland)
org: University of Maryland, A. James Clark School of Engineering
what_you_do: Stay on campus for a week of lab work, demos, lectures and a team design project. You visit each of the eight engineering departments. Only 25 to 30 students are accepted per session.
who_can_apply: Students entering 11th or 12th grade in the fall. The page does not list a GPA or location rule.
pay_detail: $1,400 per student (project materials, activities, and room and board; transportation is not included). Scholarships are available for students with demonstrated financial need.
duration: One week, residential. In 2026: Session One July 26 to 31 and Session Two August 2 to 7 (you attend one).
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 24, 2026, with notices by May 15. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with a one page personal statement. Email a recommendation from a STEM teacher and your official transcript to summerengr@umd.edu. Contact: Sandra Crespin Melgar, summerengr@umd.edu.
notes: Costs money. Price, dates and deadline above are from the 2026 page and may change for 2027.
